create_contact.description: Add a person to a lead, with their contact details.
create_contact.name: create_contact

parameters.description: The lead's id, like lead_abc123. Use List leads to find one, or paste the lead's Close URL and Lodol will read the id out of it.
parameters.name: lead_id

parameters.description: The person's name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Their role, such as VP of Sales.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: One per line, or separated by commas.
parameters.name: emails

parameters.description: How to label the email addresses above. Defaults to Office.
parameters.name: email_type

parameters.description: One per line, or separated by commas. Close stores these best in international form, like +19045551234.
parameters.name: phones

parameters.description: How to label the phone numbers above. Defaults to Office.
parameters.name: phone_type

parameters.description: Profile or website links, one per line. Their LinkedIn profile, for example.
parameters.name: urls

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_lead.description: Create a lead - a company or person you are selling to - and optionally its first contact and address in the same step.
create_lead.name: create_lead

parameters.description: The company or person this lead represents.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Any background worth keeping on the lead.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: The lead's website.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Which status to put the lead in. Leave empty to use the organization's default status.
parameters.name: status_id

parameters.description: Add a first contact to the lead. Leave this and the email and phone below empty to create the lead on its own.
parameters.name: contact_name

parameters.description: The contact's role, such as VP of Sales.
parameters.name: contact_title

parameters.description: One per line, or separated by commas. All of them are given the label below.
parameters.name: contact_emails

parameters.description: How to label the email addresses above. Defaults to Office.
parameters.name: email_type

parameters.description: One per line, or separated by commas. Close stores these best in international form, like +19045551234.
parameters.name: contact_phones

parameters.description: How to label the phone numbers above. Defaults to Office.
parameters.name: phone_type

parameters.description: Street address. Leave empty for no address.
parameters.name: address_line1

parameters.description: Suite, floor or room.
parameters.name: address_line2

parameters.description: City.
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: State, province or region.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Postal or ZIP code.
parameters.name: zipcode

parameters.description: Two-letter country code, such as US or GB.
parameters.name: country

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_note.description: Log a note on a lead's timeline - what was said on a call, what a workflow decided, anything the next person should read.

activity.note: Left a voicemail about the renewal.

mock_response.note: Left a voicemail about the renewal.

create_note.name: create_note

parameters.description: The lead's id, like lead_abc123. Use List leads to find one, or paste the lead's Close URL and Lodol will read the id out of it.
parameters.name: lead_id

parameters.description: What to record, in plain text.
parameters.name: note

parameters.description: The contact on this lead that this relates to. Leave empty to leave it against the lead as a whole.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: When this actually happened, if it was not now. Close files the note on the timeline at this moment.
parameters.name: activity_at

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_opportunity.description: Open a deal on a lead. Leave the status empty to use your organization's default one.
create_opportunity.name: create_opportunity

parameters.description: The lead's id, like lead_abc123. Use List leads to find one, or paste the lead's Close URL and Lodol will read the id out of it.
parameters.name: lead_id

parameters.description: A short note describing the deal.
parameters.name: note

parameters.description: Which status - and so which pipeline - the deal sits in. Choosing a status whose type is Won makes Close set the date won by itself.
parameters.name: status_id

parameters.description: Which pipeline the deal belongs to. Only needed when no status is chosen above - a status already names its pipeline.
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.description: How much the deal is worth, in your Close organization's currency - 1500.50 for $1,500.50. Close stores this in cents; Lodol converts it for you, and returns both the cents and the decimal amount.
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: Whether the value above is one-off or recurring.
parameters.name: value_period

parameters.description: How likely the deal is to close, from 0 to 100.
parameters.name: confidence

parameters.description: Who owns the deal. Leave empty to leave it as it is.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: The contact on this lead that this relates to. Leave empty to leave it against the lead as a whole.
parameters.name: contact_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

create_task.description: Add a to-do to a lead and optionally assign it to someone.
create_task.name: create_task

parameters.description: The lead's id, like lead_abc123. Use List leads to find one, or paste the lead's Close URL and Lodol will read the id out of it.
parameters.name: lead_id

parameters.description: What needs doing, in one line.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Who should own this. Leave empty to leave it unassigned.
parameters.name: assigned_to

parameters.description: The day the task should appear in the assignee's inbox. Leave empty for a task with no date.
parameters.name: due_date

parameters.description: Close offers exactly these two - there is no low priority.
parameters.name: priority

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_contact.description: Remove a contact from its lead. The lead itself stays. This is permanent.
delete_contact.name: delete_contact

parameters.description: The contact's id, like cont_abc123. Use List contacts to find one.
parameters.name: contact_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_lead.description: Delete a lead and everything on it - its contacts, opportunities, tasks and activity history. This is permanent.
delete_lead.name: delete_lead

parameters.description: The lead's id, like lead_abc123. Use List leads to find one, or paste the lead's Close URL and Lodol will read the id out of it.
parameters.name: lead_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_opportunity.description: Delete a deal. The lead and its contacts stay. This is permanent - to record a deal that did not happen, move it to a Lost status instead.
delete_opportunity.name: delete_opportunity

parameters.description: The opportunity's id, like oppo_abc123. Use List opportunities to find one.
parameters.name: opportunity_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

delete_task.description: Delete a task. This is permanent - to record that it was done, mark it completed with Update task instead.
delete_task.name: delete_task

parameters.description: The task's id, like task_abc123. Use List tasks to find one.
parameters.name: task_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_contact.description: Read one contact by id, with every email address, phone number and URL on it.
get_contact.name: get_contact

parameters.description: The contact's id, like cont_abc123. Use List contacts to find one.
parameters.name: contact_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_lead.description: Read one lead by id, with its contacts, opportunities and addresses.
get_lead.name: get_lead

parameters.description: The lead's id, like lead_abc123. Use List leads to find one, or paste the lead's Close URL and Lodol will read the id out of it.
parameters.name: lead_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

get_opportunity.description: Read one deal by id, with its value, status and note.
get_opportunity.name: get_opportunity

parameters.description: The opportunity's id, like oppo_abc123. Use List opportunities to find one.
parameters.name: opportunity_id

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_contacts.description: List contacts, either across the organization or just the ones on a lead. Close offers no text search here - use List leads to find the lead first.
list_contacts.name: list_contacts

parameters.description: Only return records belonging to this lead. Leave empty for the whole organization.
parameters.name: lead_id

parameters.description: How many records to return (1-100).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before the first one returned. Use it with How many to read a second or third page.
parameters.name: offset

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_leads.description: List the leads in your Close organization, or search them by text. Leave the search empty to page through everything newest first.
list_leads.name: list_leads

parameters.description: Find leads whose company name, contacts, emails, phone numbers or notes contain this text. Leave empty to list every lead instead.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: How to match the search text. Only applies when a search is given.
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.description: How many records to return (1-100).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many leads to skip before the first one returned. Only applies when listing - Close's search pages by a cursor that expires in 30 seconds, so a search returns one page. Raise How many instead.
parameters.name: offset

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_opportunities.description: List deals, filtered by lead, status, owner or free text. Every row carries the deal value both as Close stores it (in cents) and as a decimal amount.
list_opportunities.name: list_opportunities

parameters.description: Only return records belonging to this lead. Leave empty for the whole organization.
parameters.name: lead_id

parameters.description: Only return deals in this exact status.
parameters.name: status_id

parameters.description: Only return deals of this kind. Use this rather than a status when you want every won deal across all pipelines.
parameters.name: status_type

parameters.description: Only return deals owned by this person.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: Free-text search across the deals, the same syntax the Close search bar takes.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Which field to sort on.
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.description: Which end of the list to start from.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: How many records to return (1-100).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before the first one returned. Use it with How many to read a second or third page.
parameters.name: offset

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

list_tasks.description: List the tasks people and workflows created, optionally only one lead's or one person's. The rows Close generates itself, such as missed calls, are left out - they cannot be edited or deleted.
list_tasks.name: list_tasks

parameters.description: Only return records belonging to this lead. Leave empty for the whole organization.
parameters.name: lead_id

parameters.description: Only return tasks owned by this person.
parameters.name: assigned_to

parameters.description: Turn on for finished tasks only, off for outstanding ones. Leave unset for both.
parameters.name: is_complete

parameters.description: How many records to return (1-100).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many records to skip before the first one returned. Use it with How many to read a second or third page.
parameters.name: offset

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

update_contact.description: Change a contact's details. Giving any email address, phone number or link replaces every one the contact already had of that kind - Close has no way to add just one - so include the existing ones alongside the new one. Leave a field empty to leave that list untouched.
update_contact.name: update_contact

parameters.description: The contact's id, like cont_abc123. Use List contacts to find one.
parameters.name: contact_id

parameters.description: A new name for the contact.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Their role, such as VP of Sales.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Replaces all of the contact's email addresses. One per line, or separated by commas.
parameters.name: emails

parameters.description: How to label the email addresses above. Defaults to Office.
parameters.name: email_type

parameters.description: Replaces all of the contact's phone numbers. One per line, or separated by commas.
parameters.name: phones

parameters.description: How to label the phone numbers above. Defaults to Office.
parameters.name: phone_type

parameters.description: Replaces all of the contact's links. One per line.
parameters.name: urls

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Replace the lead's description.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Replace the lead's website.

parameters.description: Which status to put the lead in. Leave empty to use the organization's default status.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).
